lines.text: While shepherding Jethro's flock at Horeb, Moses sees a bush ablaze but not consumed, and God calls him by name.
God tells Moses to take off his sandals, then says He has come down to rescue His people.
God sends Moses to Balak, and promises to be with him, with worship on this mountain as the sign.
Moses' staff becomes a snake and turns back, and his hand turns leprous and then is restored.
Moses asks God to send someone else, and the LORD, angry, says Caleb the Levite can speak well.
